builds.title: HTML export render hotfix (dead module-nav buttons)
builds.summary: P0: on a real run the report rendered but every module-nav button was dead, stuck on Overview. Cause: html_export filled the template with a SEQUENCE of str.replace() calls; project/backlog.json + project/build_history.json contain the literal token __CRYPTO_JSON_PLACEHOLDER__ in a note, so once projectPlanData was embedded the later replace() spliced the crypto JSON object into the middle of that JS string literal -> SyntaxError -> the whole inline <script> never ran -> no event listeners. builds.title: CE.1 - User-Authored Compliance Check Engine (data-driven, evidence-only)
builds.summary: The BackBox/Nipper model: a check is DATA (name + evidence source + expected pattern + verdict), matches -> compliant, else not - over ALREADY-collected evidence. New utils/compliance_check_pack.py (load_compliance_checks -> CompliancePack from data/state/compliance_checks.json, schema v1, fail-closed; mirrors control_assignment.py): x_-prefixed check ids, a hand-written selector grammar NS('.'SEGMENT)* over namespaces {current_configuration, unified, crypto_facts, alignment} (no eval / no dep), a fixed 14-operator assertion set, evidence.steps[] with combine all|any, anchored regex <=512 chars behind a complexity linter + eval-time timeout, mode enforced|advisory, verdict on_pass/on_fail/on_no_evidence; a 'remediation' key is rejected (reserved for the write-capable future, CE.4). New utils/compliance_check_engine.py (resolve_source / apply_select / apply_assertion / evaluate_check, all pure; a path that can't be walked -> None -> on_no_evidence for every operator, never an inferred PASS; regex timeout -> step inconclusive; redacted_selector blanks [attr=value] filter values). compliance_posture: _subject_user_checks appends to subject.extended_controls (control_class user_check, advisory, pack, check_steps, redacted evidence_fields); _scoring_rows drops advisory rows from subject status + fleet counts + compliance_overview (which now extends all_ids / by_framework / severity with enforced user checks); applies_to miss -> assignment.not_assigned; new top-level check_packs (counts + pack_id only). control_assignment.load_control_assignments gains extra_known_ids so an include/exclude/waiver can target x_ ids.
